obernants.operator: Closed tags and Act use exact catalog membership; word grammar and field domains come from types. Text has at most 25 whitespace-separated words. Tag sets reject duplicate tags then normalize with V::tags. num accepts zero or one-to-six ASCII digits with no leading zero, or NUM_WORD tags, so 999999 is accepted; the narrower comment is not an enforced bound.
